title: 第7章 侠客点加1
slug: 穿梭时空的侠客全本免费-穿梭时空的侠客最新章节列表
content_zh:
大雨如天塌了似的铺天盖地的从天空中倾泻了下来，天雷滚滚发出巨大的轰鸣响彻天地，随着雨越下越大一道道闪电划破了漆黑的夜幕。
七月的天像是少女的脸，说变就变，方才还明月弯弯转眼间就暴雨如瀑。
陈浩手持油纸伞站在一棵茂密的大树下，他的前方是一座僻静的小院。
“这幽雅的环境倒是适合吟诗作画！”陈浩拿出酒葫芦喝了一口酒，自从来到绣春刀世界他倒是喜欢上了喝酒，他觉得明末的酒更浓香醇厚，不像后世喝下去一股化学酒精的味道。
此地是画师北斋的住所，陈浩通过城内地痞的小道消息才找到这里，他在这里是在等一个人，那人就是凌云恺，陈浩要杀他。
距离金陵楼的命案已经过了一天，这件案子沈炼和凌云恺谁都没能拿下，最终被千户陆文昭给定案了，定的是劫财害命。
随后陆文昭交给了凌云恺一个任务，让他去杀画师北斋，北斋是一名画师，经常在字画之中夹带东林党的诗文，还暗讽朝政，更作死的是还敢编排魏忠贤，东厂下了必杀的命令。
其实，东厂下令是一方面，更主要的原因是陆文昭要杀人灭口，郭真就是被北斋引至金陵楼的，杀了北斋这件案子就彻底完结了，沈炼就是因为救了北斋才被牵扯进了信王的夺位之局。
对于熟知剧情的陈浩来说，今天就是杀凌云恺最好的机会。
电影里的剧情是凌云恺去杀北斋，沈炼向来喜欢北斋的字画于是就随他一起去了，见到北斋后沈炼发现北斋竟是自己中午见过的那个漂亮女孩子，与此同时凌云恺见色起意想要先奸后杀，沈炼阻止凌云恺两人发生了打斗，最终沈炼误杀了凌云恺......
对于陈浩来说最大的难度是如何杀掉凌云恺，凌云恺的武功可不低，以他现在的实力远不是对手。
让沈炼和他一起杀那更不可能，沈炼杀凌云恺也是误杀，正大光明的杀凌云恺沈炼可没这个胆子！
到底怎么杀呢！难道指望手中的绣春刀？陈浩不自信的摇了摇头，他有些愁眉不展，不杀就没有侠客点，没有侠客点就不能升级，只靠苦练提升实力那速度太缓慢了！
“尊敬的宿主，遇到问题时你为何不动用自己的底牌呢？”就在这时一道声音自陈浩脑海中响起。
突如其来的声音并没有惊吓到陈浩，他知道这是侠客系统的声音。
只是他有些奇怪，以前都是自己问询侠客系统才会回复，为何这次它主动开口了呢，于是陈浩试探性的问道：“我能有什么底牌？”
“宿主你从来都没看过你的储物空间，里面可有你前世的物品呢！”侠客系统提示道。
储物空间！陈浩懊恼的拍了下脑门，竟然把这个给忘了！
关于如何使用侠客系统陈浩已经驾轻就熟了，他连忙用意念召唤储物空间，顿时他的脑海中出现了一个1立方米大小的储物柜，里面陈放着三件物品，一件是钱包，一件是钥匙，还有一件赫然是一把手枪。
陈浩大喜过望，他没想到地球的物品也随他的灵魂一起来到了这方世界。

“手枪。”他心中默念了一声，储物空间里的手枪瞬间出现在了他的手中。
这是一把9mm警用转轮手枪，弹巢内还有满满的六发子弹，云缅边境比较混乱，像陈浩这种干了两年协警又立过功劳的人，在抓捕犯人的特殊时间段临时配给手枪是允许的。
陈浩热切的抚摸着手中的枪，有它在手杀凌云恺那是易如反掌了。
踏、踏、踏！
不远处的小路上突然传来了一阵轻微的脚步声，若不是陈浩精神集中还不一定听得到，他赶忙躲在了大树后面，小心翼翼的观察着情况，只见两个身披蓑衣的锦衣卫往北斋的小院走去。
来了？陈浩心中一喜，来人正是沈炼和凌云恺，他们二人只在小院门前停顿了一会便走了进去。
陈浩待二人进去一小会他才缓缓的走进小院，停在了北斋东屋的窗户外面，也就是北斋居住的那间屋子。
“沈炼暗通逆党你算攥在我手里了......你真当凌某怕你吗.......”
陈浩躲在窗外暗听着屋内沈炼与凌云恺激烈争执声，好像是到了凌云恺诬陷沈炼暗通逆党的桥段，陈浩并没有马上进去，他在等待一个时机，一个杀了凌云恺沈炼也不会埋怨他的时机。

content_en:
Heavy rain poured down from the sky like the sky was falling. The thunder roared loudly and resounded throughout the world. As the rain got heavier, lightning struck through the dark night.
The sky in July is like a girl's face. It changes at a moment's notice. The moon was shining brightly just now, but in the blink of an eye it's raining like a waterfall.
Chen Hao stood under a dense tree with an oil-paper umbrella in hand. In front of him was a secluded courtyard.
"This elegant environment is suitable for reciting poems and painting!" Chen Hao took out the wine gourd and took a sip of wine. Since coming to the world of Xiuchundao, he has fallen in love with drinking. He feels that the wine in the late Ming Dynasty is more fragrant and mellow, unlike the smell of chemical alcohol in later generations.
This place is the residence of the painter Beizhai. Chen Hao found this place through the gossip of the local gangsters in the city. He is waiting for someone here, that person is Ling Yunkai, and Chen Hao wants to kill him.
One day has passed since the murder case in Jinling Tower. Neither Shen Lian nor Ling Yunkai was able to solve the case. In the end, Lu Wenzhao of Qianhu decided to take the case as a crime of robbery of property and murder.
Then Lu Wenzhao gave Ling Yunkai a task, asking him to kill the painter Beizhai. Beizhai was a painter who often included Donglin Party poetry and prose in his calligraphy and paintings. He also made innuendoes about the government. What was even more dangerous was that he dared to arrange Wei Zhongxian. Dongchang gave the order to kill him.
In fact, Dongchang gave the order on the one hand, and the main reason was that Lu Wenzhao wanted to kill someone and silence him. Guo Zhen was led to Jinling Tower by Beizhai. The case of killing Beizhai would be completely over. Shen Lian was involved in King Xin's seizure of the throne because he saved Beizhai.
For Chen Hao, who is familiar with the plot, today is the best opportunity to kill Ling Yunkai.
The plot in the movie is that Ling Yunkai went to kill Beizhai. Shen Lian had always liked Beizhai's calligraphy and painting, so he went with him. After meeting Beizhai, Shen Lian discovered that Beizhai was the beautiful girl he had met at noon. At the same time, Ling Yunkai wanted to rape and then kill Ling Yunkai. Shen Lian stopped Ling Yunkai and the two had a fight. In the end, Shen Lian accidentally killed Ling Yunkai...
For Chen Hao, the biggest difficulty is how to kill Ling Yunkai. Ling Yunkai's martial arts is not low, and with his current strength, he is far from his opponent.
It was even more impossible for Shen Lian to kill Ling Yunkai with him. Shen Lian's killing of Ling Yunkai was also a manslaughter. Shen Lian didn't have the guts to kill Ling Yunkai justly!
How to kill! Are you counting on the embroidered spring knife in your hand? Chen Hao shook his head unconfidently. He frowned a little. If you don't kill, you won't have knight points. Without knight points, you can't level up. It's too slow to improve your strength just by practicing hard!
"Dear host, why don't you use your trump card when you encounter problems?" At this moment, a voice sounded from Chen Hao's mind.
The sudden sound did not frighten Chen Hao, he knew it was the sound of the knight system.
It's just that he was a little strange. In the past, he had to ask the knight system himself before replying. Why did it take the initiative to speak this time? So Chen Hao asked tentatively: "What trump card can I have?"
"Host, you have never seen your storage space. Are there items from your previous life in it?" the knight system prompted.
Storage space! Chen Hao slapped his forehead in annoyance and forgot about this!
Chen Hao was already familiar with how to use the Knight System. He quickly summoned the storage space with his mind. Suddenly, a 1 cubic meter locker appeared in his mind. There were three items in it, one was a wallet, one was a key, and the other was a pistol.
Chen Hao was overjoyed. He did not expect that the items from the earth would also come to this world with his soul.
"Pistol." He muttered silently in his mind, and the pistol in the storage space instantly appeared in his hand.
This is a 9mm police revolver, with six rounds of bullets in the cylinder. The Yunnan-Myanmar border is relatively chaotic. People like Chen Hao, who have worked as police co-operators for two years and have made meritorious deeds, are in the special moment of arresting criminals.Temporary distribution of handguns between periods is allowed.
Chen Hao touched the gun in his hand eagerly. With it in his hand, it would be easy to kill Ling Yunkai.
Step, step, step!
Suddenly there was a soft sound of footsteps on the path not far away. If Chen Hao hadn't been concentrated, he might not have heard it. He hurriedly hid behind the big tree and carefully observed the situation. He saw two Jinyi guards in raincoats walking towards Hokusai's small courtyard.
Coming? Chen Hao was overjoyed. The visitors were none other than Shen Lian and Ling Yunkai. They only paused in front of the courtyard door for a while and then walked in.
Chen Hao waited for the two of them to enter for a while before he slowly walked into the small courtyard and stopped outside the window of Hokusai's east room, which was the room where Hokusai lived.
"Shen Lian secretly communicates with the rebels, you are in my hands... Do you really think Ling is afraid of you..."
Chen Hao hid outside the window and secretly listened to the fierce argument between Shen Lian and Ling Yunkai inside the house. It seemed that Ling Yunkai was about to frame Shen Lian for being a treacherous party. Chen Hao did not go in immediately. He was waiting for an opportunity, an opportunity that would kill Ling Yunkai and Shen Lian would not blame him.
